notes.title: 【Update1126】Added two ancient monster bosses challenge
notes.notes:
Dear fellow exorcists,

In this update, you will be challenged by the two ancient monster bosses. Either character can entre the challenge after clearing the full game once!

Version: 1.59.1125.0

[b]New content:[/b]

Added two new challenge levels, Tāo tiè and Táo wù, have been added. Either character can entre the challenge after clearing the full game once!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/fc23493a633b15d09cb412246bf06ddc8e5d44c0.png[/img]

[b]梼杌 Táo wù/b]
One of the four legendary beasts of ancient times, the body is the spirit of vegetation, and its nature is free and loose. According to legend stories, the character of Táo wù was stubborn, brave and fierce, and it is able to fight without retreat. In thousands of battles, it has cast a bronze wall and iron wall, and there is no one who can fight in close combat. With the passing of time, Ying Xiao has long been disdainful of fighting with the weak, and usually only uses his tail clone to observe the world.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/dfbab0c29df5095d635de8a1a0614b5a80d59155.png[/img]

[b]饕餮 Tāo tiè [/b]
One of the four legendary beasts of ancient times originated from Gouwu Mountain. It is naturally greedy . The world calls it gluttonous, gluttonous for money, and gluttony for gourmet. It has only a head with no body, which is said to have been transformed by the head of the ancient god of war after death; there are also rumors that Gourmet will not let anything out of his eyes, and eat all his limbs, leaving only a huge head.

notes.title: 【斩妖秘籍】“斩” 的修行（新手斩妖人必看）
notes.notes:
[b] 基础操作十大心法之——斩
[/b]
临近完整版上线，看到有好多初入江湖的斩妖人加入了我们，真的很开心~ 也看到了不少玩家反映游戏的体力不够，所以我们决定在十大心法第一期重点来讲讲“斩”~

 
“斩”是角色操作进阶的核心，也是贯穿始终对耐力控制起到良性作用的招式。特点简而言之——高伤害，高连携，无耐力消耗！

 

下面两张动图，请各位斩妖人观察怪物的血条以及角色的体力条：

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/0564837a17da8d262bce5a4b0b90431eba83bde1.gif[/img]
普攻4连击


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/22b23b0e3d0d693353675f573514dc93039bf4e0.gif[/img]
普攻3连击+斩


各位斩妖人应该可以看出：

1.“斩”攻击威力强大，比较普通攻击具备更高的输出伤害。

2.  “斩”不会消耗耐力，而且在“斩”释放的过程中，耐力条便会开始恢复。

 

在讨伐恶妖的死战中，仅一息之差便可能殒命当场。想要保持耐力源源不断，熟练且合理的打出“斩”非常的必要。

 

l  斩的释放方式。

在基础攻击的第三招间隙，闪避反击，蓄力重击，破，跳劈，下劈攻击后，都会出现一个聚气特效的提示，在这个时间点，迅速按下攻击，就能触发“斩”攻击。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/22b23b0e3d0d693353675f573514dc93039bf4e0.gif[/img]
普攻+斩


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/275dffffb8966dfa354bad678c511a035238abb9.gif[/img]
蓄力+斩


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/4c3ac3c296894e3ac37560b07916a2b84ceacfa5.gif[/img]
闪避反击+斩

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/f6e1c1a6dc4d93d957dec453717806fae50e1da0.gif[/img]
弹返+斩


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/339cc3c0e8d316251ecea244bc497b33b2f7332a.gif[/img]
跳劈+斩


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/b1ae56ddfa6aeba874239a458e0fd5d339e60017.gif[/img]
下劈+斩


普攻、蓄力重击、跳劈、下劈攻击皆会消耗耐力对敌人造成伤害，紧接着释放“斩”会有效回复耐力，并形成连续技对敌人造成大量的伤害。

完美闪避反击，破招反击（这两个招式完美释放了会出“闪”和“破”字）则不会消耗耐力，并对敌人造成较高的伤害。之后紧接着释放“斩”可以对敌人造成持续的更强的伤害。

综上所述，“斩”可以作为所有招式的终结技，也是回复耐力的最佳选择，更是斩妖人们的克敌利器。各位斩妖人快快一起把“斩”操练起来吧~！


最后提一句，在我们暂停界面的“教学”里可以看到各种操作的教学哦~

notes.title: 【Eastern Exorcist · Devlog】 Game Art
notes.notes:
Hey fellow exorcist!

As the official launch date is approaching, we would love to share more about the game's development process with you, so that we could review the journey we've traveled this year, together with our old friends who have been following us, and at the same time introducing the world of 'Eastern Exorcist' to our new players!

Today's development story is told by the art team behind the game.


The art of Eastern Exorcist has always been one of the highlights of the game. which makes our art teammates breathed a sigh of relief, in fact, at the beginning of the development, we weren't sure which style to go with; cartoon or realistic, American manga or Japanese manga. Everything feels 'good', but at the same time, everything is not 'good' enough.

So we went through researches on many indie game titles,  and we really feel the importance of a game's art style. It must be unique, and in line with the game's own worldview and background, 

At the end, we decided to try out something with Chinese watercolor painting.(ง •_•)ง

In the initial stage, we think of the full picture of all the art performances with the expression of Chinese painting, here comes the birth of our first ever picture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/f89f3bb44a7408cd19c961897bd433615c3fb9ed.png[/img]

The traditional Chinese painting could really show the mountains and clouds, in a moody way by using haloing. We decided to use ink haloing to make a distant scene, so that the picture becomes stronger in space and also provides a special mood.

The flowers, birds, insects, fish and plants are particularly depicted in Chinese painting. For the flowers and plants in the focal layer, we refer to the common shapes in Chinese painting, fully hand-painted, hoping to ensure that the shapes have enough flavor of Chinese painting, while striving to make the sense of volume stronger and also strengthen the richness of colors.

We hope to make the whole picture through this method, showcasing both the traditional painting feel and modern painting's realistic look, with the general direction, we began the second concept design:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/163ec9e18f5fea5975d00512d66db74fac3d8987.png[/img]

After the concept of the map came out, the team agreed that the effect is 'not bad', so we began to do a few other levels following this style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/ab053819561979b686881a43b7f52c290892ac49.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/d9feb5bc232d8c9c45cb26fe98aa211e81f2e43b.png[/img]

Finally, all materials will be imported into the 3D scene in accordance with the distance of the view, devided into far, medium, and near.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/525525327f39217e14e4a31e9664d9bb06fc6e26.png[/img]

Our vision is to use the traditional hand-painted Chinese ink painting style together with a more modern technique, in combination to create a variety of different scenery and immersion in the world of Eastern Exorcist, while enjoying the game itself, players could also experience the unique charm of the Oriental ink.

notes.title: 【Eastern Exorcist · Devlog】 Half-Fox female character - Xiahou Xue
notes.notes:
Hey fellow exorcist! 

How do you like our new trailer? Excited to introduce our new playable character, Xiahou Xue, who is a Half-Fox female character, with a whole new story and new skills!

This character will be unlocked together with the game's 1.0 version, (on July 8)

Living in Mingzhou City, a girl of half-demon descent, in order to save her loved ones, she did not hesitate to commit dangers and fight against powerful enemies with her own strength and embarked on an adventure.....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/25a3dce4fe0a1af5db0d3f22a42d70695bc20e92.png[/img]

At the initial stage of the project, in order to enrich the experience and different tastes of the players. We have determined the plan for the male and female double protagonists, unfortunately, there was a delay in development, our EA version only discloses the content of the male protagonist. 
But actually, the male and female double protagonists would make up to be the full version of the game. (ง •_•)ง。

In-game character development has always been a core focus within our team. We very much hope that through the accumulation of experience and continuous attempts to complete the shaping of each role, we will present to everyone the oriental magical world we want to show. I also sincerely hope that everyone can enjoy the story of the Eastern Exocist series.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/1ec09eb42a87a0e4f8dfdc1caa6faa89fe41bc45.jpg[/img]
[i]【some character sketches】[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/bdd7308fe960b0a697e2c7e227dc20b77fb23779.png[/img]
[i]【Xiahou Xue movement designs, she use to have red hair in the early versions 】[/i]

When constructing the stories of the two characters, we hope to take our players to try out two different experiences. The half-demon heroine would be more lively and young (in age), Compared with the much heavier story of the male character, we hope that the heroine can bring you a playful and more relaxed plot and experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/2c107f119aa807e120ef15d38ebce703e79c5055.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536611/7386a2cd087fb441e660d0679e09cfdc9cc9d26b.png[/img]

Additionally, the female protagonist's operating game feel is slightly different from that of the male protagonist. 
The use of heavy weapons will slightly slow down the output, but there will be enhancements in the air and attack power. It can be said that each has its own advantages and disadvantages. In terms of skills, the heroine will have a set of her own brand-new skills, but there will also be similar skills as our male character, we will also introduce to you later.

Finally, we look forward to seeing everyone try out our new half-demon girl-Xiahou Xue! See you soon!

Hello Exorcists,

The main aim of this update is to improve the game experience and fix bugs. The controls will respond better now, and you can stop the use of Charged Attack at any time. Please refer to the changelog below for more details.

Thank you all in the community for your feedback and support. We will continue to monitor responses in the community and work to optimize your gameplay experience. We plan to focus on optimizing skills and boss battles in future updates, so please stay tuned! 

[h3]Functionality Improvements:
[/h3][olist]
[*] [Controls] We’ve changed the controller settings to try to solve the occasional controller signal error.
[*] [Key Settings] We’ve added a shortcut key for the map.
[*] [Screen Settings] We’ve added a vertical sync selection.
[*] [Reset] This function now requires a long press to confirm the action and complete it. This will help to avoid triggering it by accident.
[*] [HUD] Adjustments were made to the lower right corner of the display showing the increase and decrease in Power points to make the changes more visible.
[*] [Charged Attack] Effect has been optimised.
[*] [Exclamation Point Warning] Prompts show more dynamically now, based on actual attack strength and TGH difference.
[/olist]

[h3]Bug Fixes:
[/h3][olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where the player’s strike resulted in an insta-kill of all enemies under certain circumstances. 
[*] Fixed the button prompt error that shows up when opening the mini-map with PS4 controllers which are wired. 
[*] We’ve made changes to try to fix the problem of Colonel Yin dropping into the ground in the boss battle.
[*] Fixed the issue where visibility of hints in Challenges were blocked due to the change to New Game+.
[*] Corrected some misspellings. 
[*] Fixed a bug where going into a tutorial stage and exiting quickly, then clearing a Challenge stage would return your character back to Wuli Lake.
[/olist]


[h3]Game Experience Adjustments:
[/h3][olist]
[*] [Charged Attack] We’ve improved the activation triggers to solve the problem of accidentally starting the Charged Attack process while pressing other controls. 
[*] [Charged Attack] The Charged Attack can be cancelled at any time by using Break, Dodge or Dash.
[*] [When attacked] You can now cancel out the post-attack action by tilting slightly upwards using Dodge and Dash. 
[*] [New Game+ Experience] The Power of enemies will increase significantly with each replay.
[*] [New Game+ Experience] The enemy stats will be adjusted upon replay. Stats will increase significantly.
[*] [Dark Shadow Spell] Mana acquisition efficiency has been adjusted.
[*] [Dark Shadow Spell] Adjusted part of the triggering of shadow attacks, and improved the problem where shadows were being limited by terrain when attacking.
[/olist]

----------
As the game is still in EA now, our team will continue to communicate with all our supporters and combine feedback to make the game better. We value and welcome your feedback.

See you next time, Exorcists.

notes.title: Eastern Exorcist Early Access Update
notes.notes:
Hello Exorcists,

Hello Exorcists, it’s been almost a week since the release of Eastern Exorcist in EA. We would like to thank every Exorcist for your support!

This is a post to tell you more about what we have planned in Phase Two. Since the last round of updates, the production team has been working on the problems which have been highlighted to us, in addition to fixing bugs. We’ve gone through a round of optimisation and polishing to bring this patch to you. Please update the game for an improved experience! 

Once again, thank you for your support of Eastern Exorcist! 

[h2]Update 2 Changelog：
Version：1.13.0819

[h3][Improved Functionality][/h3]
[list]
[*] Tutorial tips do not pop up in NEW GAME+ and Trial modes.
[*] The NEW GAME+ tutorial level is skipped.
[*] More functions added to skills and ways to use skills. The skills which have already been activated in the [Skill Tree] can be clicked on and removed after confirmation. You will get 60% of your Power and all your Essence back.
[/list]

[h3][Bug Fixes][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where there were inaccuracies in the monster movement mapping.
[*] Fixed a bug where some flying enemies remained hovering after being weakened (or after the boss monster shield was broken).
[*] Fixed a bug where there were occasional freezes in dialogue in certain situations.
[*] Fixed the inaccurate duration of the [Nirvana] effect of the [Vajra Spell].
[/list]

[h3][Gameplay Experience Adjustments][/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve tweaked the feel of [Jump], and the protagonist can now stay in the air for longer, and has better aerial maneuverability.
[*] The interval between [Aerial Attack] attacks have been shortened significantly, and has better hovering capabilities. Stamina consumption has been reduced by 33%, so you can now perform continuous attacks in the air.
[*] Parameters for the execution of [Perfect Dodge] can be met more easily now.
[*] The [Dodge] and [Dash] usage intervals have been shortened, and maneuverability of continuous [Dodge] and [Dash] actions have been greatly improved.
[*]  [Perfect Dodge Counter Attack] will now eliminate the projectiles and ground effects (fire on the ground, poison, etc.) from enemies in the middle of your advance.
[*] You can now control the direction of your [Dodge Counter] by holding down the arrow keys. 
[*] The movement mechanism of [Charged Attack] has been reworked. It is now a two-stage stamina system. There will no longer be an automatic cancellation when the Stamina has been overcharged. Players will never miss the chance to activate it.
[*] You can still attack before the first stage is complete. It will be as powerful as a normal attack.
[*] When you’ve charged it fully in the first stage, the power of the attack is the same as the Charged Attack effect.
[*] When you’ve charged it fully in the second stage, shield-breaking and damage are significantly increased.
[*] A 20% reduction in shield breaking performance for [Jumping Slash] [Downward Slash].
[*] [Skill Adjustments]: [Water Dragon Chant] increases the mana recovery for [Riverside House], [Cool Breeze] and [Imbibe], speeding up mana circulation.
[*] [Skill Adjustments]: The [Water Dragon Chant] [Long Sword Summon] can now eliminate projectiles and ground effects (fire on the ground, poison, etc.) from enemies within striking range.
[*] [Skill Adjustments]: The firing position of the [Sword Spell] [Flying Flame Swords] has been adjusted to avoid overlapping with the character, and [Flying Flame Swords] will now automatically lock on to the target.
[*] [Skill Adjustments]: [Sword Spell] [Qi Practice Spell III] has an increased mana recovery mechanism, shortening the cooldown for [Cold Ice] and [Red Flame].
[*] Adjusted the behavioural pattern of Wraiths in Chapter 2, so they will not wander about for a long time.
[*] Adjusted the Dragon boss combat experience. 
[*] Added the Dragon boss transition animation.
[*] Adjusted the number of Wraiths summoned by the Treant boss. Increased tips for the Treant’s person-attraction spell.
[*] Fixed the problem with the boss attack decision frames. 
[*] Shields on some Challenge bosses have been raised overall to solve the problem of them being too vulnerable.
[/list]

–––––––

Known bugs (which will be fixed in an update coming soon): Text display in the map interface of the PS4 controller.

As we’ve hoped in publishing the game in EA, the development team will be paying attention to every comment and message, and keep in touch with all of you in the official group and community. We will collect all of your feedback to make the game better. We welcome everyone to join the group and give us your valued feedback and comments.

See you all next time, Exorcists!

notes.title: Eastern Exorcist Early Access
notes.notes:
Hello Exorcists,

It's been a day since Eastern Exorcist was launched. Our team was pleasantly surprised by the warm welcome from the community. Many of you also gave us valuable suggestions and playthrough impressions of the game.

[b]Thank you all for giving such great support to Eastern Exorcist!
[/b]
We treat every comment and review you give us with importance. Thank you all for your compliments to the art style, and we will keep making more beautiful scenes in future content updates.

However, we know that the game is still not perfect. We’ve decided to share upcoming changes in the game with you today.

[h2]Update 1 Preview：
[/h2][h3]1. Adds distribution –> adds distribution will be changed according to the different difficulty settings.
[/h3]The original idea of putting adds in the boss fight stage was to allow players to have quick stamina recovery by killing or parrying the adds. However, the actual game experience needs more polish. These are the changes we’ll make in Update 1:
[Casual/Normal] Remove all the adds during the boss fight.
[Hard] Keep the adds, but decrease their strength.
[Hard] Adding an achievement: Defeat all the challenge stages in hard mode.

[h3]2. Aerial combat –> Weaken enemies in the air and buff aerial attack efficiency.
[/h3]It will be a long-term task for us, as we plan to keep adjusting the aerial combat experience.
In future updates, we plan to weaken all the aerial enemies, including the boss, Chu.

[h3]3. Stamina system –> Reduce the stamina cost in [Casual] difficulty
[/h3]The stamina system is one of the critical features of the game, so we will keep collecting feedback to improve the system.
We are planning to reduce the stamina cost in [Casual] difficulty significantly.

[h3]4. English localization –> A brand new version of the translation is coming!
[/h3]We are working with some experienced translators to bring a better localized version to the Western community.
The update for a better translation is coming soon!

All the plans and details optimization will be completed as soon as possible in the follow-up updates. Please take note of the recent official announcements to be informed of the specific update times.
